summary: Tests-writing phase for issue #39 (adopt generated OpenAPI client + solver parity corpus). Wrote the solver-parity corpus test vendoring color_matching's committed corpus byte-identically, plus wire-contract pinning tests for the PaletteAPIClient migration, and corpus-consumption docs. No Swift toolchain exists in this container (verified: no swift/swiftc anywhere on the system), so `swift test` could not be executed here; parity semantics were validated instead by replaying the corpus in Python with IEEE-754 semantics identical to WeightedSquaredErrorScorer (all 12 scenarios exact, including the 5 tie cases, 2 no-selection cases, and 4 exclusion cases), and the Swift tests must be executed by `swift test` (bin/lint) on a macOS/Swift host. Implementation of the generated client is deferred to the paid-tests-approved implementation run, per phase rules.
